name: Ichijou Otome
source:
Avatar name: Otome (オトメ)
Class: Fencer (rapier user)

A girl who was chosen as a beta tester of "Aerial Life."

Since she's a member of track club, she has good motor skills.
Actually always been in love with the protagonist, but he graduated before she could confesses her feelings.
In order to be accepted in the same university as the protagonist, she studies hard and does her best at club activities.
